notes.title: Single Player Update
notes.content:
[h1]Single Player Support[/h1][p][/p][p]You can now [b]play against the computer[/b] in 1v1, 1v2 or 2v2 matches.[/p][p]If you play with a buddy, you can choose either to have a CPU teammate each and play against each other, or face off together against two CPU opponents.[/p][p]CPU players have three difficulty levels:[/p][list][*][p][b]Drunk[/b] (easy)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tipsy[/b] (medium)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sober[/b] (hard)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Side view added[/h1][p]Turns out it wasn't that difficult to implement, so I've added the option to switch to a side view.[/p][p]There are two options:[/p][list][*][p][b]Fixed Side View[/b]: the camera shows the whole playfield[/p][/*][*][p][b]Dynamic Side View: [/b]the camera frames and follows the players plus the ball.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Other minor fixes[/h1][list][*][p][b]Graphics elements[/b] added to Ship scene.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Controller assignment[/b] redesigned.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Keyboard support has been enhanced[/b], mostly in terms of GUI.[/p][/*][*][p]Several bugs fixed.[/p][p] [/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p]

tags.feature: You can now [b]play against the computer[/b] in 1v1, 1v2 or 2v2 matches.
Turns out it wasn't that difficult to implement, so I've added the option to switch to a side view.
[b]Graphics elements[/b] added to Ship scene.
[b]Controller assignment[/b] redesigned.
[b]Keyboard support has been enhanced[/b], mostly in terms of GUI.

notes.title: Update One notes
notes.content:
[h1]New stuff:[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Implemented localization.[/b] Supported languages are English, Hungarian, Polish, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Brazilian Portuguese, French, Russian, Spanish and German.
[*] Added feature to[b] invite Steam Friends in-game[/b] via Remote Play Together.
[*] [b]Implemented goalpost indicators.[/b] They indicate the direction of attack when the goalpost is off-screen.
[*] [b]Implemented keyboard support.[/b] Available for one local player only.
[*] Added ability to [b]grab and hold nearest enemy player[/b] with hands.
[*] Added [b]simple [/b]and [b]advanced control scheme[/b]
[/list]

[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Endless OUT loop bug.
[*] Adjusted collision matrix so player foot collides with less objects, thus making it easier to get around obstacles
[/list]

[h1]Changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Changed gamepad layout to better suit grabbing feature.
[*] Temporarily disabled Tutorial until controls are confirmed.
[/list]

[h1]Removals:[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Removed feature vertical jump.
[*] Removed camera free look. It was confusing players.
[/olist]
